div.h2: Stop emailing files to yourself just to print
div.p: You do not need to buy an expensive Wi-Fi printer. Print Ofo bridges your Android phone with any existing USB printer connected to your computer.

ul.li: ⚠️ Emailing or WhatsApping photos to yourself to print from PC
⚠️ Buying costly Wi-Fi enabled printers (₹15,000+ cost)
⚠️ Slow, unreliable Bluetooth printing that drops connection
⚠️ Third-party cloud apps sending private documents through foreign servers
⚠️ 'No installed printers available' errors when sharing from phone gallery
✓ Direct 1-tap Share from Android Gallery or File Manager
✓ Turns any normal USB printer into a high-speed wireless printer
✓ 100% offline local Wi-Fi transfer — documents never touch the cloud
✓ Automatic reconnect on PC startup (UDP Port 8089 beacon)
✓ Full print layout controls: Color/B&W, Copies, Paper Size, Fit to page

div.h2: Everything you need for seamless printing
div.p: Designed for studios, small businesses, cyber cafes, and home offices that demand rock-solid printing without cloud dependencies.
Uses smart UDP discovery on port 8089. Even if your Wi-Fi router changes your laptop's IP address, the mobile app automatically reconnects without re-pairing.
Communicates directly with the Windows Native Print Spooler (`System.Drawing.Printing`). If Windows can print to your printer, Print Ofo can print to it!
Select any photo or PDF in Android Photos, Gallery, or WhatsApp, tap Share > Print Ofo, and send it straight to your physical printer in seconds.
Your documents, identity proofs, invoices, and personal photos stay completely inside your local home or office Wi-Fi network. No cloud accounts required.
The desktop server automatically launches in your Windows system tray upon computer startup. Your print server is always online and ready when you are.
Fine-tune every print job: Color or Monochrome, A4, 4x6 Photo Paper, Legal, Custom Scaling (Fit/Fill), Duplex printing, and Page Range selection.
Tested and verified on industry-standard laser, inkjet, tank, and thermal printers.

div.h2: Start printing in less than 2 minutes
div.p: No technical background required. Just follow these three simple steps.
Download and run `Print_Ofo_Setup.exe` on your Windows 10/11 computer. It installs in seconds and shows your 6-digit security PIN and QR code.
Open Print Ofo on your Android phone (on the same Wi-Fi or laptop hotspot). Scan the QR code or enter the PIN once. You're paired!
Open any photo in your phone gallery or PDF document. Tap Share > Print Ofo, select your printer, adjust copies, and hit Print!
Get the latest official release for Windows Desktop and Android Mobile.

div.h4: 🌐 Does Print Ofo require an active Internet connection?
div.p: No! Print Ofo operates 100% offline over your local Wi-Fi router or laptop mobile hotspot. Even without internet, printing works flawlessly at full local network speed.

div.h4: 🔌 Can I print to older USB printers that don't have Wi-Fi?
div.p: Yes, absolutely! That is the primary purpose of Print Ofo. As long as your printer is connected to your Windows laptop or PC via a standard USB cable, Print Ofo lets you print to it wirelessly from your mobile phone.

div.h4: 📱 Do I need to enter the 6-digit PIN every time I print?
div.p: No. You only pair once. Print Ofo saves a secure authentication token on your phone. When you turn on your PC, it automatically connects in the background.

div.h4: 🛡️ Is my personal data or printed documents stored online?
div.p: Never. Print Ofo has zero cloud servers, zero telemetry, and zero document storage. Print data is streamed directly from your phone to your computer's RAM/Spooler via encrypted local HTTP/HTTPS.
